limitations: These captured comparisons and form-factor sweeps are not visual approval; every reviewStatus remains unreviewed.
Physical-device and OEM review, human split-screen/freeform approval, full-speed and frame-by-frame motion approval, performance, and endurance evidence remain open.
The Argent simulator-server failed to start on the new headless tablet and foldable AVDs, so those lossless captures use Android adb screencap; phone screenshots and cross-platform diffs use Argent.
The Arabic RTL sweep exposes documented English fallback phrases that remain pending translation review.
Emulated OPENED, HALF_OPENED, and CLOSED posture captures do not substitute for physical hinge and outer-display testing.
Direct iOS-to-Android comparison reports the expected 1206x2622 versus 1080x2400 dimension mismatch; normalized comparisons are diagnostic and do not establish pixel identity.
